# `dashboard/views/prompts.ts`

## Overview

Provides HTML rendering functions for the prompts dashboard UI. This module implements a two-panel prompts management interface, including a full page layout and HTMX-compatible partial views for dynamic editor updates.

---

## Exports

### `promptsPage`

Renders the full prompts page with a two-panel layout: a left sidebar containing the file list and a right panel containing the editor.

```ts
import { promptsPage } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `files` | `PromptEntry[]` | List of prompt file entries to display in the sidebar. |
| `user` | `SessionUser` | The currently authenticated session user. |

#### Returns

`string` — An HTML string representing the complete prompts page.

#### Example

```ts
import { promptsPage } from '...'

const html = promptsPage(files, user)
res.send(html)
```

---

### `promptEditorPartial`

Renders an HTMX partial for the editor panel of a single prompt file. Intended for use as a dynamic partial response swapped in via HTMX.

```ts
import { promptEditorPartial } from '...'
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `relativePath` | `string` | The relative file path of the prompt being edited. |
| `content` | `string` | The text content of the prompt file. |

#### Returns

`string` — An HTML string representing the editor panel partial.

#### Example

```ts
import { promptEditorPartial } from '...'

const partial = promptEditorPartial('system/base.txt', 'You are a helpful assistant.')
res.send(partial)
```

## Internal Functions

### `fileTreeItem`

> ⚠️ This function is **not exported**. It is for internal use only and cannot be imported directly.

Renders a single file tree entry for display in the sidebar file list.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `entry` | `PromptEntry` | A single prompt file entry to render as a tree item. |

#### Returns

`string` — An HTML string representing one item in the file tree.
